title: feat: zoom to cursor on scroll wheel without Ctrl/Cmd
body:
## Summary

- **Mouse wheel zoom to cursor** — scroll wheel now zooms toward the cursor position by default, without requiring `Ctrl`/`Cmd`. This matches the UX behaviour most users expect from design and diagramming tools.
- Minor: Docker Compose volumes configured to store persistent data in a local `./data` directory (git-ignored) for easier local development and backups.

## Test plan

- [ ] Open the editor and scroll the mouse wheel — canvas should zoom toward the cursor without holding any modifier key
- [ ] Holding `Ctrl`/`Cmd` while scrolling should still work as before
- [ ] Docker Compose `up` creates a `./data` folder for volumes
